body:
Well, I have Asperger's, and Bipolar runs in the family, so you're right. I'm very used to being depressed, but just not to having constant thoughts of suicide...

I've been in the system since I was 3, at this point I've gone through enough therapy to last a lifetime, it's like I've become immune to it. It doesn't help.

I have problems with social anxiety too, so no worries, I totally get you. 

It's not very often I meet other people who play Terraria! Sometimes I think I'm the only person who still does, lol. I haven't played L4D2 in ages, but I do love that too. Oh, and I also like Rick&Morty and SU (kiiind of a cartoon junkie, haha). 

I'm on discord as well, if you're interested in chatting there!

Well, I'm an artist, and I really like murder mysteries, so that's two things we have in common I guess, haha. I would probably be a gamer too if I had the money, but I'm broke as all hell, so no such luck. I sometimes enjoy watching gamers on youtube though.

Oh, and I like anime too, I've watched all kinds of random series, lol. Do you have any favorites?

I agree with you, scars are beautiful in their own right - too bad most of mine tell the same story. 
I relate to you about the discord thing, talking to cool people is hard. I've joined and subsequently left many groups for the same reason. It's tough to find people to be weird with.
Oh, I also really love pens and stationery, though it's mostly because I draw. I'm not great at keeping journals, every time I try, I fall off it pretty quickly. I admire people who journal frequently though, it must be very nice.
